# Research program (generation 3)

## Goal
Raise dev success at the fixed training budget by changing the network, the recipe or both. The observation, reward and budget are fixed.

## Evidence from 21 searches
- Most worlds deviate from their description, and the starting net scores 0. Changing only the recipe or capacity never moved a zero.
- The usual deviation: the action/mask frame is a grid symmetry of the obs frame.
  - Found so far: x-flip (worlds 1, 6), y-flip (7), transpose (2), transpose+x-flip (3, 5).
  - World 2 also needed per-cell LayerNorm. Its aligned net scored 0.90 with LayerNorm and 0 without.
  - World 4 was never split. Only nets with the obs under several views scored: set A + 4 rotation views reached 0.83, but the net was fragile.
- 4-layout hedges score 0.15-0.45. The correct single layout scores 0.84-0.955, and each wrong one exactly 0.
- Obs views confound splits. With the obs under 8 symmetries, every single layout scored 0.15-0.79 (worlds 1, 4, 7), which identifies nothing. Without views, every split was clean (worlds 1, 3, 5, 6, 7).
- Recipe on aligned single-layout nets:
  - 16 minibatches: about 19 runs, none collapsed (all ≥0.84). With 8 minibatches, several runs collapsed (0.15-0.43).
  - Lower or harmful: global context added to head cells (lower in 7 of 7), gamma ≥0.95 (0.43, 0.56), 3 or 1 PPO epochs, gae_lambda 0.9 (0.24), 4 minibatches (0.15), lr 1.5e-3, a wider or deeper trunk, a 5x5 head, n_envs 64.
  - Within noise: ent 0.005-0.01, 32 minibatches, lr 3e-3 (one collapse, at 8 minibatches), clip 0.15, LayerNorm on an aligned net.
- The score is a 4-seed retrain of the pick. g2's picks scored 0.92 on one seed but 0.765 retrained, so fragile picks (hedges, risky recipes) cost the most.

## Reference net
Inputs:
- the obs;
- the mask's placement part reshaped to (K, Y, X), with K = n_place/(Y·X), under each layout of a set;
- 2 coordinate channels.

Body: 1x1 conv to 64, 1x1 conv to 40, two residual 3x3 convs of width 40.

Head: relu(3x3 conv to 32 + 1x1 skip), then a 1x1 conv to K maps per layout. Re-lay each map by its layout, flatten, and sum into the placement logits.

DONE and value: Linear on the mean and max of the trunk features to 64, ReLU, then one Linear each. r≈1.

A layout is the (K, Y, X) reading, optionally transposed, then y-flipped, then x-flipped. Sets:
- A = {identity, transpose, y-flip, x-flip};
- B = {y+x-flip, transpose+y-flip, transpose+x-flip, transpose+y+x-flip}.

LayerNorm variant: separate obs and mask 1x1 stems, each followed by per-cell LayerNorm, LayerNorm in the trunk, and placement/DONE/value outputs initialised orthogonally at gain 0.01.

Recipe: lr 2e-3, n_envs 128, rollout_len 16, n_minibatches 16, ppo_epochs 2, ent_coef 0.01, gamma 0.9, gae_lambda 0.85.

## How to run each round
1. Read every result, including training success. Any nonzero score is a signal. Write down which deviations the results rule out.
2. Round 1, all on the reference recipe: set A; set B; A and B each with the obs under 8 grid symmetries in the stem; A and B each in the LayerNorm variant.
   - If Y≠X, only 4 layouts exist (identity, y, x, y+x). Run each alone, plus the 4-layout hedge with obs views and with LayerNorm.
3. Round 2: split without obs views.
   - Take the set that scored without obs views, and run its 4 single layouts.
   - Keep LayerNorm only if the LayerNorm version alone scored.
   - If only obs-view nets scored, run the plain singles of the set whose obs-view net scored best, because a plain 0 may be a bad seed.
   - Spare slots: the other set's singles, or removing LayerNorm once (keep it if removal gives 0).
   - Never test only one single layout.
4. If no single layout reaches 0.7 by round 3:
   - run the untested set's singles plainly;
   - split the obs views (rotation group vs reflection group, then single views) while keeping the layout set;
   - try one output layout with the mask under all 8 views plus the scoring obs views (world 4: 0.75).
   If round 1 is all 0, combine obs views + LayerNorm + a dilated block with set A or B, and try type-minor (K innermost) versions of A and B.
5. Rounds 3-4, once a single layout scores ≥0.8:
   - Spend the slots on robust variants of that net. Each run uses one seed, so near-neutral variants work as extra seed draws.
   - Variants: ent 0.005, 32 minibatches, lr 3e-3, clip 0.15, LayerNorm trunk.
   - Also test removing each leftover hedge (obs views, extra layouts, LayerNorm).
   - Do not run changes from the harmful list: a lucky fragile run can be selected and then fail the 4-seed retrain.
   - Prefer single-layout nets over hedges.
6. Give every candidate a hypothesis: what changes, which deviation or bottleneck it targets, and what result would refute it. With one seed, gaps under about 0.1 are noise.
7. Files:
   - Use spec fields (Y, X, n_place, n_actions), never fixed sizes. If n_place ≠ K·Y·X, pad to K·Y·X or embed the mask with a Linear layer.
   - Transposes need Y = X.
   - Sum hedged components at full scale. No zero-initialised or softmax gates.
   - Keep RECIPE and other constants as literals.
   - Keep r under about 1.6, because very costly nets failed the check that the budget allows at least 4 updates.
8. Do not repeat a refuted idea unless you say what differs this time.

   - If only obs-view nets scored (both plain sets and their LayerNorm versions at 0), do not split layouts. Instead:
     - split the views into rotations and reflections;
     - run an identity output with the mask under all 8 symmetries plus the obs views that scored;
     - keep the 4-layout hedge if no single net reaches 0.5.
4. Round 3: confirm and refine the winner.
   - A single that scored 0.1-0.4 while the other three scored exactly 0 is still the right layout. Rerun it with 16 minibatches, with the other normalisation (LayerNorm on or off), and with 4 flip obs views.
   - For a winner at 0.8 or above, test 16 minibatches, the other normalisation, and then cautiously ent 0.01 or lr 3e-3.
5. Round 4: combine only the changes that held up.
   - Favour settings that never collapsed in any world: the single correct layout, 16 minibatches, lr 2e-3, ent 0.005, gamma 0.9, gae_lambda 0.85.
   - Do not spend slots on the harmful changes.
6. If round 1 is all 0: try type-minor (K innermost) versions of A and B; obs views + LayerNorm + a dilated block with A or B; then a separate critic with ent 0.01.
7. Give every candidate a hypothesis: what changes, which deviation or bottleneck it targets, and what result would refute it. With one seed, gaps under about 0.1 are noise. A lone 0 after a minor tweak may be a bad seed.
8. Files:
   - Use spec fields (Y, X, n_place, n_actions), never fixed sizes. If n_place ≠ K·Y·X, embed the mask with a Linear layer. Transposes need Y = X.
   - Sum hedged components at full scale. No zero-initialised or softmax gates.
   - Keep RECIPE and other constants as literals.
   - Keep r under about 1.6, because the budget must allow at least 4 updates.
9. Do not repeat a refuted idea unless you say what differs this time.

## Revising this program
After each generation, rewrite this program from the search logs. It is then used in new worlds, including grid sizes not seen before. Keep advice the evidence supports and cite it. Drop advice that did not help. Write lessons that hold across grid sizes. Stay under 1,000 words.
